title: Wrap every perception media read in the media-worker role context via one shared helper
summary: Role-sensitive scratch and input reads for perception commands belong inside the perception_media_worker execution context; extract the wrap as a shared helper so each new perception path inherits the authorized context in one place, and verify each path plus a denied-access case separately.
hint_triggers: MSN-PERCEPTION-ROLE-20261031 fixed see/watch role violations by wrapping confidential scratch and input reads in the perception_media_worker execution context, then extracted the wrap as a shared helper (withPerceptionMediaRole) so later perception paths get the same authority boundary by construction. Verification reported 48 focused tests green; keep per-path and denied-access results separate so success and the authorization boundary stay attributable, and document residual floor-grant gaps as intentional limits.
